I would like you to create me a three-year plan that is very concise and includes important milestones along the way.

Key points:
- I want the plan to be on how I can grow my online presence and publish a cookbook.
- I'm not sure whether to self-publish or go the more traditional route.
- I currently have 1.2M followers who follow me for my quick, healthy recipes.
- I work four days weekly on this endeavor, and I have limited time and budget.

Please come up with a plan for me based on all this.
